race.comment: Hard to rule too many of these out. BONDI BLOSSOM (5) floundered on a soft track at the Kensington track when second-up from a spell recently - best to forget that run. Fitter for two runs back from a spell and the mile brings out her best. Perfectly drawn and ready to feature. EQUILIBRIST (4) gave away a big start so did a good job to clock in just 1.8 lengths from the winner over 1400m at Warwick Farm last time out. Has won five races, all at Kembla. Tough to hold out over the extra 200m today. Last start Orange winner YES SIREE (9) can find the provincials a bit of a test but that last win under 60kgs was tough. ME ME (10) is finding the line with purpose and looks ready for a first try at 1600m.
